name: frontier-infra
description: Help developers build standalone governed agent systems with Frontier Infra patterns and SDK components.

interface.longDescription: Developer tooling that helps Codex build standalone governed agent applications without tying the target architecture to one model, coding harness, or dashboard. The coding assistant remains outside the runtime while it implements contracts, deterministic control boundaries, independent verification, runtime health, and optional evidence receipts with Frontier SDK components.
defaultPrompt: Build a standalone governed agent application with Frontier SDK.
Add Frontier SDK runtime components to my application.
Audit this deployed agent runtime against The Machine.
